description: Schema for YAML frontmatter in SKILL.md files. Frontmatter is delimited by --- markers at the top of the file.

name.description: Canonical skill identifier. Lowercase kebab-case, optionally prefixed with a namespace and colon for vendored skills (e.g. 'cr', 'ckm:brand').

description.description: One-line summary of what the skill does and when to trigger it. Used in skill discovery and the skill listing.

agent.description: Name of a specific subagent type to use when running this skill (e.g. 'reviewer').

argument-hint.description: Short usage hint shown alongside the skill name (e.g. '[PR番号 | staged | branch]').

tools.description: Tool restrictions for this skill. Single string or list of allowed tool names / patterns.

allowed-tools.description: Explicit allowlist of tools the skill may use. Same semantics as 'tools'; prefer 'allowed-tools' for clarity.

paths.description: File glob patterns; the skill is auto-suggested when an active file matches one of these patterns.

license.description: SPDX license identifier for vendored/third-party skills (e.g. 'MIT').

metadata.description: Arbitrary key-value metadata (e.g. author, version, mcp-server). Not interpreted by the harness.
